retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist composition featuring a white castle emerging from a heart-shaped rock formation floating in a blue sky with ethereal light rays.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, vertically-oriented surrealist object consisting of a multi-towered white castle with a single red conical roof, resting upon a base of blue-grey rocks that taper into a sharp heart-like point. A floating stone staircase leads from the bottom edge toward the castle's entrance, set against a soft blue gradient sky with diagonal light rays emanating from the top right.
coreVisualRelationships: Castle towers nested within a heart-shaped rocky base
Floating staircase creating a diagonal path toward the central subject
Ethereal light rays intersecting the upper right quadrant
Symmetrical central subject balanced by asymmetrical light and stairs
coreInvariants: The heart-shaped silhouette of the central floating landmass
The single red accent on the central tower's conical roof
The soft, airbrushed gradient of the blue sky background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The castle-heart hybrid is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 50% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white castle with its red roof acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the floating stairs from the bottom center upward and rightward, leading to the castle, then follows the light rays back down.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive blue sky provides significant negative space, emphasizing the isolation of the floating subject.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red on the central tower roof and door
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low-to-medium saturation with soft transitions characteristic of airbrushing.

letterConstructionRules: Top logo uses aggressive, forward-leaning cursive with long horizontal swashes
Bottom text uses wide-tracked, elegant Roman serifs
Sharp, blade-like terminals on the script lettering
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'B' in the top logo feature exaggerated, overlapping loops
The 'E' characters in the script are stylized as parallel horizontal strokes

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the lower sky and stairs

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, hand-drawn script for the brand name paired with a calm, widely-spaced serif for the title.

preserve: Wide tracking of the bottom text
The sharp, italicized lean of the top script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, wide-tracked serif style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed surrealist painting of a white castle with a red roof sitting on a heart-shaped rock floating in a blue sky with light rays and a floating stone staircase.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a sharp, white, italicized custom script logo at the top and a wide-tracked, elegant black serif title at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is there a single red roof among the white towers?
Is the bottom text tracking extremely wide?
Are the light rays coming from the top right?

mustRedesign: Do not use exact font files
Ensure the heart shape is integrated into the rock, not a separate icon
postGenerationChecks: Verify the heart-shaped rock tapers to a point
Check that the red roof is the only major color pop
Ensure the stairs lead the eye toward the castle
Confirm the sky has a smooth gradient
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist [Subject A] merged with [Shape B] floating in [Atmospheric Environment] with [Directional Light] and [Path Element].
